notes: Single-core RISC-V; WiFi + BLE 5 on board.
Firmware is authored as ESPHome YAML, not a raw Arduino sketch.
WiFi / OTA secrets are injected via !secret at compile time — never inline them.

config_schema.name: ip_address
config_schema.required_message: ip_address is required (use the ESP32-C3's IP on your LAN)

config_schema.name: wifi_ssid
config_schema.required_message: wifi_ssid is required so the firmware can join your network

config_schema.name: wifi_password
config_schema.min_length_message: wifi_password must be at least 8 characters
config_schema.deny_list_message: wifi_password '{value}' is a deny-listed default — pick something stronger

config_schema.name: ota_password
config_schema.min_length_message: ota_password must be at least 8 characters
config_schema.deny_list_message: ota_password '{value}' is a deny-listed default — OTA without strong auth lets anyone on your LAN flash anything.
